Account.title: Account
Account.description: Chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the Dutch RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard (REQ-WBSO-001). Master data; queried by every Transaction and report. Hierarchy is capped at five levels and circular references are forbidden by schema constraint.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Account changes (renames, status flips, parent-account relocations) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-WBSO-004 / ADR-022 — every change influences downstream GL reporting and tax aggregations.

x-openregister-constraint.description: Enforces REQ-WBSO-001 — chart-of-accounts depth is capped at five levels per administration; circular references are detected by the same walker.

parent.description: FK to the parent account (REQ-WBSO-001); the parent MUST live in the same administration and be in `status=active`.

accountType.description: Semantic category per the Dutch Accounting Standard (REQ-WBSO-001).

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber in the same administration; null when the account is a root (REQ-WBSO-001).

status.description: Operational status (REQ-WBSO-001). Only `active` accounts can serve as parents.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Phase 1 is EUR-only (REQ-WBSO-001).

description.description: Free-text notes on the account purpose.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT applies to transactions on this account.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Financial event (invoice, receipt, journal-entry, credit-note, debit-note) recorded by a bookkeeper (REQ-WBSO-002). State machine: `draft → posted → (terminal)` and `draft → reversed`. Posted transactions are immutable; reversals are recorded as new transactions linked through the audit trail (REQ-WBSO-008).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Transaction changes MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-WBSO-004 / ADR-022. Posted records carry the booked state of the books; mutating them would violate the audit trail.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Entered but not yet posted; can be edited and deleted by bookkeepers (REQ-WBSO-002 / REQ-WBSO-008).

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Counter-entry created by an administrator. Both the original and this reversal remain in the audit trail (REQ-WBSO-008).

post.label: Post transaction
post.description: Validate and post the transaction. GL posting is deferred to tier-2 `bookkeeping-general-ledger` (REQ-WBSO-008).

reverse.label: Reverse transaction
reverse.description: Reverse a posted transaction. Requires an approval-workflow gate (administrator or auditor approval — REQ-WBSO-008 / ADR-022).

administration.description: FK to the Administration entity (REQ-WBSO-002 / ADR-022).

transactionNumber.description: Unique transaction identifier (e.g. INV-2026-001). Unique per administration.

transactionDate.description: ISO-8601 date the transaction occurred — MUST fall in the active fiscal year.

amount.description: Amount in EUR (REQ-WBSO-002). Reversals carry a negative-mirroring sibling record per REQ-WBSO-008 — the originating row's amount is always non-negative.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of creation. Set by the server.

createdBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the creator. Set by the server.

reversalOfTransactionId.description: When `status=reversed`, the id of the original posted transaction this row reverses (REQ-WBSO-008).

reversalReason.description: Free-text reason captured by the administrator at reverse-time (REQ-WBSO-008).

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Bookkeeping document metadata (invoice PDF, receipt scan, contract, tax form, bank statement, memo) (REQ-WBSO-003). Files live in docudesk; this record stores the metadata and lifecycle (draft → filed → archived per REQ-WBSO-007 / REQ-WBSO-009).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Document lifecycle transitions MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-WBSO-004 / ADR-022. Archived documents MUST remain in the audit trail even when the file is purged from docudesk (REQ-WBSO-009).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Created but not yet filed. May be edited and deleted by the owner (REQ-WBSO-003).

filed.label: Filed
filed.description: Approved and locked. Counts toward statutory retention (REQ-WBSO-007).

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Past the seven-year retention window. The file MAY be purged from docudesk; the metadata row remains for audit (REQ-WBSO-009).

file.label: File document
file.description: File a draft document for compliance. Requires `fileReference` to be set and a bookkeeping-approver to approve the transition (REQ-WBSO-007 / ADR-022).

archive.label: Archive document
archive.description: Archive a filed document past the seven-year retention boundary. Requires an auditor or compliance-officer approval (REQ-WBSO-009 / ADR-022).

documentDate.description: ISO-8601 date the document was issued or created.

fileReference.description: URI pointing to the file in docudesk storage (e.g. `docudesk://invoices/inv-2026-001.pdf`). Required to transition draft → filed (REQ-WBSO-007).

createdAt.description: Timestamp of creation. Set by the server.

createdBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the creator. Set by the server.

filedAt.description: Timestamp when the document transitioned to `filed`. Set by the server on the `file` transition (REQ-WBSO-007).

archivedAt.description: Timestamp when the document transitioned to `archived`. Set by the server on the `archive` transition (REQ-WBSO-009).

archivalReason.description: Free-text reason captured by the auditor at archive-time (REQ-WBSO-009).

objects.description: Sample posted invoice to Customer ABC

objects.reversalReason: Customer ABC disputed scope; reversal issued for re-invoicing.
